summary: Frontend-only testing of offline-write-queue fixes for reader.html silo readings & morts save, and morts-entry.html staff Mort Buddy page (FIX 1/2/3). All three E2E tests PASSED. Verified data landed in DB via /api/integrations/morts.

test_results.morts_entry_load: PASS — page loaded past 'Loading sheds…' into 30 shed cards. The main agent's screenshot_tool timeout was a headless/screenshot-tool artifact, NOT a real bug. Playwright loaded shed cards within ~3s and all data-testid='save-shed-*' selectors resolved (30 buttons). Backend API /api/farm-config and /api/integrations/morts responded normally.
test_results.TEST_1_morts_entry_happy_path: PASS — filled staff name 'QA Test', morts=3 for shed 1, clicked save-shed-1 → toast displayed 'Shed 1 saved' (honest success, not queued).
test_results.TEST_2_reader_happy_path: PASS — reader.html loaded (silo readings tab default), filled first silo amount=5, clicked Save → toast displayed '✓ Saved — flowing to Feed Program' and inline 'SAVED' badge appeared under the shed group.
test_results.TEST_3_offline_queue: PASS — set_offline(True), filled shed 2 morts=2, clicked save-shed-2 → toast 'Shed 2 queued — will sync when back online' (NOT a false 'saved'). Offline banner [data-testid='staff-offline-queue-banner'] appeared visible with text '📡 Offline — 1 item queued, will sync when back online'. Set_offline(False) + dispatched 'online' event → banner disappeared within 5s (auto-sync triggered).
test_results.backend_verification: PASS — GET /api/integrations/morts?farm=default&since=2026-09-12 returned BOTH test entries: [{shed:1, morts:3, staffName:'QA Test', updatedAt:'2026-09-12T09:06:09'}, {shed:2, morts:2, staffName:'QA Test', updatedAt:'2026-09-12T09:06:15'}]. The offline-queued shed 2 entry did land in DB after auto-sync, confirming the queue is honest AND functional end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: The 'main agent screenshot tool got stuck on Loading sheds' issue is a bot-detection/headless-render artifact of the screenshot_tool, not an app bug — Playwright (also headless Chromium) loads the page fine. Main agent should not treat that tool's timeout as evidence of a real bug.
Preload warnings for /style-data.json and /feed-program.xlsx appear in console on both reader.html and morts-entry.html — non-blocking but should have proper `as` attributes or be removed.
